SCOPE: The phase diff c85ef735..c0fd0e92 touches the 7 week files w02-w08 (approval.text draft to approved, commit ccf3d95c), three covers test files, the plan, run files, and, outside this track's code, the print-track Phase 4 files (picture-check.ts, readers.ts, make-readers-pdf.ts, check-storytime-pictures.ts). dashboard/lib/storytime/print/covers.ts is absent from the phase diff, so the B-P1-01 guard and the escaping layer are unchanged from Phase 1. The only production code change in this track's scope is make-storytime-book-cover.ts (174586b6, 4 insertions, 1 deletion): the print default branch and `panelValues = approvedValues`.

ADV-P2-1 OUT PATH: With --print and no --out, an integer version >= 3 resolves out to <print-ready>/storytime/print-v<version>/l<level>u<unit> (script lines 210-211); the non-print v3 default stays proof-v3 (storytimeCoverDefaultOutDir, pinned by the 16books test); version 1 or 2 without --out still exits 2. The default branch value then flows through the same checkStorytimeCoverOutDir call (line 223) as an explicit --out, before any data load, temp folder, mkdir, or browser launch. The guard resolves the target through its deepest existing ancestor (storytimeCoverRealPath) and rejects equality with or containment in any existing proof or proof-v<n> folder, and rejects a symlinked fixed output file. A print-v<n> default can never collide with a proof-v<n> folder. My gate run confirms ADV-P2-OUT, ADV-P2-DEFAULT v3, ADV-P2-DEFAULT v4, and ADV-P2-GUARD all pass.

ADV-P2-2 D12 FILTER: Script lines 251-262. approvedWeeks filters levelWeeks on week.approval.text.status === 'approved'; approvedValues is computed from the approved weeks only; a missing field returns 1 with an error that names the book and the field, before mkdtemp and before mkdirSync(out); then panelValues = approvedValues. assets.panelValues and the report's chosenPt both read the same panelValues, so the printed panel and the report agree. The story field is gated inside storytimeCoverPanelValues: its text is used only when every named source week is in the approved context, so an unapproved week cannot re-enter through the data file. Mutants M28 (print default disabled) and M29 (approvedValues removed) were caught at 85c327d9 (committed evidence jr-green-85c327d9-mutants.txt). My gate run confirms both ADV-P2-D12 cases pass, including the only-week-3 case that reads real page text and asserts no week-3-only word leaks.

INPUT VALIDATION: --level and --unit must be integers 1 to 4; an unknown option exits 2; --version must be an integer >= 1 and is checked before the guard runs; the print default branch re-checks Number.isInteger(version) so a NaN or fractional version cannot enter the print-v<n> path. The stderr of my gate run shows the exit-2 paths live. Known residual lows are already routed elsewhere: a missing --out value resolves to the cwd (adversarial ADV-P2-R2-2, Review C C3-P2-01), and --version is validated after the default branch (Review C C3-P2-01). Neither is a shipped-path risk.

ESCAPING AND QR: covers.ts is unchanged in this phase. escapeCoverText escapes &, <, >, and " for the title attribute and the panel values; contact lines flow through richHtml as in Phase 1; the QR SVG uses the fixed constant STORYTIME_LINE_ADDRESS (https://line.me/ti/p/Pf7_EF98Pv), never argv data. Panel headings are module constants. No value from a week file or the data file reaches an unescaped attribute.

NETWORK AND SECRETS: The build renders local file:// pages in Chrome and calls pdfinfo and make-pdfx with execFileSync. No authentication, tenant boundary, or secret exists in this flow. The one network edge is known and low: make-pdfx downloads the Adobe ICC profile when the HOME cache is empty (adversarial ADV-P2-R2-1); tests seed the cache. Error output prints error.message and field names; no token or credential is in scope.

PERSISTENCE: The out-dir guard and all data checks run before mkdtempSync (line 274) and before mkdirSync(out) (line 338). The D12 stop returns 1 before any output folder is created; the ADV-P2-D12 tests assert nothing is written. Temp files live in a mkdtemp folder under os.tmpdir and are removed in a finally block. A failure after rendering starts can leave partial outputs in the output folder; this was recorded in Phase 1 and is not a D12 requirement. No migration is in scope.

The plan Owner gate row records Daniel's exact words ("3. Covers: Approved"), the date 2026-11-01, the PM relay source, and the SHA-256 of the approved text file. No named-subject publish surface and no consent artifact is required for this content type; A2 is satisfied.
